verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own Workflows feature, which runs an automated action when an incident event fires: auto-publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. Only that single status-page use case is evidenced; the pack does not show a general condition-based engine covering reminders or field changes. Missing for 10: documented condition/filter logic, reminder/nudge automation, automatic incident field changes, breadth of triggers and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, a condition-based workflow engine automates the toil — updates, reminders, field changes — triggered by incident events

citations.quote: With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
